seed.title: Your potential is taking root.
seed.explanation: You are in the early exploration and foundation-building stage. Your result is not saying you lack potential—it shows where to create clarity and begin turning existing experience into BA capability.
seed.focus: Create Clarity and Recognise Your Starting Point

sprout.title: Your BA foundation is beginning to show.
sprout.explanation: You already demonstrate some relevant thinking, experience or development. Your next move is to strengthen the right foundations and apply them consistently in a Business Analysis context.

growing.title: You have meaningful capability to build on.
growing.explanation: You have a credible combination of analytical behaviour, transferable experience and BA development. A focused gap is preventing that capability from becoming fully job-ready evidence.

established.title: Your BA readiness is well established.
established.explanation: You already show strong readiness across several signals. Your opportunity is targeted: sharpen how you evidence, position or communicate that capability for the roles and outcomes you want.

careerClarity.label: Career Clarity
careerClarity.explanation: Your strongest next move is understanding how Business Analysts work in practice and choosing a focused entry route.

nextSteps.title: See the BA role in context
nextSteps.text: Learn how BAs investigate problems, work with stakeholders and support change from start to finish.

nextSteps.title: Map your current experience
nextSteps.text: Identify examples where you already clarified needs, solved problems or improved how work was done.

nextSteps.title: Try one realistic BA task
nextSteps.text: Use a simple business scenario to practise asking questions, framing the problem and documenting what you find.

careerClarity.programmeHeading: Get a clear, supported route into Business Analysis.
careerClarity.programmeText: Anderseed’s career mentoring and guided BA journey can help you replace uncertainty with a clear role picture, focused learning plan and first practical evidence.
careerClarity.cta: Show Me a Clear Route Into BA

baFoundations.label: BA Foundations
baFoundations.explanation: You need a more focused command of the core BA techniques that connect analysis, people, processes and requirements.

nextSteps.title: Focus on essential BA techniques
nextSteps.text: Prioritise problem framing, stakeholder analysis, process mapping and requirements over collecting disconnected theory.

nextSteps.title: Use each technique in context
nextSteps.text: Practise on one realistic business problem so the techniques become decisions rather than definitions.

nextSteps.title: Build a deliberate development plan
nextSteps.text: Sequence what to learn, practise and evidence so every activity moves you closer to job readiness.

baFoundations.programmeHeading: Build the foundations employers expect to see in action.
baFoundations.programmeText: Anderseed’s live mentorship helps you understand the essential BA techniques, then apply them within one connected project journey.
baFoundations.cta: Help Me Build Strong BA Foundations

appliedExperience.label: Applied Experience
appliedExperience.explanation: Your main opportunity is turning knowledge into practical BA work and evidence you can confidently show and explain.

nextSteps.title: Work through one realistic business case
nextSteps.text: Investigate a complete problem instead of practising isolated BA templates.

nextSteps.title: Create portfolio-ready artefacts
nextSteps.text: Produce stakeholder, process, requirements and solution evidence that shows how you think.

nextSteps.title: Practise explaining your decisions
nextSteps.text: Turn each artefact into a clear story about the problem, your analysis and the value of your recommendation.

appliedExperience.programmeHeading: Turn BA learning into evidence employers can trust.
appliedExperience.programmeText: Anderseed’s guided portfolio project gives you realistic BA work, feedback and connected artefacts—not another theory-only course.
appliedExperience.cta: Help Me Build Practical BA Evidence

transferableEvidence.label: Transferable Evidence
transferableEvidence.explanation: You already have relevant experience, but its Business Analysis value is not yet visible or persuasive enough.

nextSteps.title: Mine your experience for BA behaviours
nextSteps.text: Find specific examples of understanding needs, solving problems, improving processes and coordinating people.

nextSteps.title: Translate examples into BA language
nextSteps.text: Describe the decisions, evidence, stakeholders and outcomes behind what you did.

nextSteps.title: Use the strongest evidence consistently
nextSteps.text: Carry the same credible examples through your portfolio, CV, LinkedIn and interview stories.

transferableEvidence.programmeHeading: Make the BA value in your experience impossible to miss.
transferableEvidence.programmeText: Anderseed combines career mentoring, CV and LinkedIn support with practical project evidence so your existing value and new capability reinforce each other.

marketPositioning.label: Market Positioning
marketPositioning.explanation: Your capability needs to be positioned more clearly for the roles, recruiters and application decisions you are targeting.

nextSteps.title: Target the right BA opportunities
nextSteps.text: Focus on roles where your domain experience, evidence and current development create a credible match.

nextSteps.title: Reframe your professional story
nextSteps.text: Lead with relevant outcomes and BA evidence across your CV, LinkedIn and applications.

nextSteps.title: Use application feedback as evidence
nextSteps.text: Track responses and refine the positioning that is not creating enough recruiter interest.

marketPositioning.programmeHeading: Position your evidence for the opportunities you want.
marketPositioning.programmeText: Anderseed’s CV, LinkedIn and application support helps you connect your capability to recruiter expectations without restarting your BA journey.

interviewReadiness.label: Interview / Communication Readiness
interviewReadiness.explanation: You are reaching an important point in the market; the next opportunity is communicating your BA thinking and evidence with greater structure and confidence.

nextSteps.title: Build a focused BA story bank
nextSteps.text: Prepare examples covering stakeholders, processes, requirements, ambiguity and problem solving.

nextSteps.title: Explain your reasoning, not just activity
nextSteps.text: Show how you investigated, made decisions, managed trade-offs and created value.

nextSteps.title: Practise under realistic interview pressure
nextSteps.text: Use mock questions and feedback to make strong examples easier to recall and communicate.

interviewReadiness.programmeHeading: Turn interview opportunities into stronger conversations.
interviewReadiness.programmeText: Anderseed’s interview preparation and mentor feedback helps you communicate your evidence with the structure, confidence and relevance employers need.
